summary: VineBrook Homes Trust filed an 8-K reporting that indirect subsidiaries VB Thirteen and VB Fourteen entered a $25.0 million credit agreement with The Ohio State Life Insurance Company on September 28, 2026. Only $4.0 million funded at signing, with the remaining $21.0 million due by October 2, 2026. The loan matures September 28, 2027, bears 10.0% interest payable monthly, carries a 1.0% origination fee and a 1.0% exit/prepayment fee, and is secured by pledges of OP and borrower membership interests plus property-sale proceeds. A non-recourse carve-out guaranty applies. Watch for the delayed funding and lender-affiliate relationship to NexPoint.
